acceptanceCriteria: Cancelled leave shifts in POS View Shifts show strikethrough on date, time, and location
Cancelled rows use subdued styling to distinguish from active shifts

subtasks.title: Auto-approve admin Create Time Off
subtasks.description: Time off created from Admin Create Time Off is approved immediately and overlapping shifts are cancelled.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Time Off in admin saves request as APPROVED
Overlapping scheduled shifts are cancelled on create
Success banner reflects approved status

subtasks.title: Block duplicate time off for same staff and dates
subtasks.description: Reject new time off when the same employee already has pending or approved leave on overlapping dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Create Time Off rejects overlapping PENDING/APPROVED requests for same employee
POS time off create rejects overlapping PENDING/APPROVED requests
Declined requests do not block new applications for same dates

subtasks.title: Decline approved time off (Admin + POS)
subtasks.description: Allow managers to decline/revoke approved leave; restore CANCELLED_LEAVE shifts back to SCHEDULED.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Time Off list shows Decline on approved rows
POS Approvals tab lists approved requests with Decline action
Declining approved leave restores cancelled shifts in date range

subtasks.title: POS Sales Targets tile (PIN-first)
subtasks.description: Add Sales Targets POS tile matching competitor layout: PIN first, then greeting and Monthly Sales Target status/sold/progress/remaining.
acceptanceCriteria: Tile tap always prompts for PIN before opening modal
Modal shows greeting, monthly progress copy, and Status/Sold/Progress/Remaining rows
API returns employee monthly target progress for POS after verify

subtasks.title: Edit sales target must not create new staff rows
subtasks.description: Editing a sales target should update that row only; adding/changing staff must not createMany extra entries.
acceptanceCriteria: updateTarget updates the existing SalesTarget row only
Edit modal uses single-staff selection
Saving an edit does not create additional list entries

subtasks.title: POS Sales Target order attribution (Order details + Post-purchase)
subtasks.description: Enable Sales Targets on POS Order details and Post-purchase so staff can PIN-verify and attribute order totals to monthly soldAmount.
acceptanceCriteria: sales-target extension targets order-details and purchase.post block/menu/modal
Attribution API fetches order total via Admin GraphQL and credits snapshot soldAmount once per order
Already-attributed orders show staff and amount without double credit

subtasks.title: Remove products from commission Include Specific Products list
subtasks.description: Allow removing individual or checked products from the commission program specific-products list without reopening the resource picker.
acceptanceCriteria: Each product row has a remove control that drops that product from the list
Remove Selected removes all checked products from the list
Removing products marks the form dirty for the save bar

subtasks.title: POS Commission order attribution (product rules)
subtasks.description: Add Commission POS blocks on Order details and Post-purchase; calculate earnings from commission program product rules after PIN.
acceptanceCriteria: commission extension targets order-details and purchase.post block/menu/modal
Commission calculated from active programs (all/specific products, fixed/percentage, after discount, limited time)
One attribution per order persists commission total and line breakdown

subtasks.title: PIN-first Commission and Sales Target attribution entry points
subtasks.description: Order details and Post-purchase attribution blocks/menu items prompt for staff PIN before opening the attribution modal.
acceptanceCriteria: Sales Target attribution block and menu item show native PIN pad before presentModal
Commission attribution block and menu item show native PIN pad before presentModal
Successful PIN persists session so the modal opens already verified
